{
  "name": "buildpane",
  "displayName": "Build Pane",
  "version": "0.1.9",
  "description": "Turns build, test and lint output from tsc, cargo, go, pytest, jest, gradle and more into a live pane of errors by file, and hands Claude the diagnostics instead of the raw log.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Gary Riches",
    "url": "https://github.com/griches"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/griches/buildpane",
  "repository": "https://github.com/griches/buildpane",
  "supportUrl": "https://github.com/griches/buildpane/issues",
  "documentationUrl": "https://github.com/griches/buildpane#readme",
  "privacyPolicyUrl": "https://github.com/griches/buildpane#what-it-does-on-your-machine",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "build",
    "tests",
    "lint",
    "diagnostics",
    "typescript",
    "rust",
    "go",
    "python",
    "mod"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "condense": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Condense what Claude reads",
      "description": "Replace the raw output in the tool result Claude reads with the parsed errors, warning counts and failed tests. The transcript keeps the raw output.",
      "default": true
    },
    "warnings": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Warnings Claude reads",
      "description": "count: Claude reads how many warnings each file has. list: Claude reads every warning.",
      "options": [
        "count",
        "list"
      ],
      "default": "count"
    },
    "autoOpen": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Open the pane",
      "description": "failure: when a run fails. always: when a run starts. never: only on /buildpane.",
      "options": [
        "failure",
        "always",
        "never"
      ],
      "default": "failure"
    },
    "compactRow": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Compact transcript row",
      "description": "Draw a condensed run in the transcript as a verdict and its first errors instead of the raw output.",
      "default": true
    }
  }
}
